note: The official 11-page DDP Curriculum for the 2026-2027 intake was downloaded as a 1,015,815-byte PDF with SHA-256 6378a739dc8065a30c3ed79870919c82a992d207489b2493a89c1d3ad71c2f1d and verified through full text extraction and visual review of every rendered page. It publishes 72 CUHK Major units and 39 THU Major units, with cross-institution credit transfer, two study options and different total and self-development requirements by student origin. This supplement exposes 131 unambiguous Programme-local courses: 9 coded CUHK-side required-list entries including the additional THU degree-fulfilment MATH1550 requirement, 28 CUHK Social Science Faculty Package candidates, 41 CUHK Major electives, 4 THU Major required alternatives, 25 THU Major electives and 24 THU self-development courses. The THU self-development table assigns code 40512513 to both Human-AI Interaction Design and Digital Operations and Business Simulation Gaming; both ambiguous rows are excluded rather than selecting a title or inventing a code. General Education, language, political-thinking, physical-education, practice-training and other study-pattern requirements are not treated as a closed Programme course pool. Because the two study options, origin-specific requirements, transfer-credit rules, alternate courses and the official duplicate-code conflict are not closed by the local rule engine, this course list is browse-only with totalCreditRequired=0 and no graduation completion percentage.
